description: National Medicines Regulatory Authority - Amend the Medical Device Pricing Regulations published in Gaz. Ex. Nos. 2086/37, 2030/47 and 2006/45
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Health under the National Medicines Regulatory Authority Act, specifically amending pricing regulations for medical devices. The content focuses on establishing legal/regulatory frameworks for medical device pricing, which falls under Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes or structural modifications.
